decisions.decision: Ms. Bertram recused herself from the retiree health coverage discussion due to a conflict as a former Town employee and elected official.

decisions.decision: Board agreed it needs to adopt CORI procedures fairly quickly and specify the circumstances that determine when CORI checks are run.
